```yaml
name: Bump Progressive Rollout Version Command

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'Pull Request Number'
        required: true
        type: number
      comment_id:
        description: 'Comment ID (optional, for reference)'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  bump-progressive-rollout-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install airbyte-ci
        run: |
          pip install airbyte-ci

      - name: Get PR details
        id: pr_details
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }};
            const pr = await github.rest.pulls.get({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: prNumber
            });
            core.setOutput('head_sha', pr.data.head.sha);
            core.setOutput('base_ref', pr.data.base.ref);
            core.setOutput('head_ref', pr.data.head.ref);

      - name: Bump version with RC suffix
        run: |
          # Determine the base branch to compare against for modified connectors
          BASE_REF="${{ steps.pr_details.outputs.base_ref }}"
          
          # Run the bump-version command with --rc flag for progressive rollout
          airbyte-ci connectors --modified bump-version --rc --base-ref $BASE_REF

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
          # Check if there are changes to commit
          if ! git diff --quiet; then
            git add .
            git commit -m "chore: bump connector versions for progressive rollout"
            git push origin HEAD:${{ steps.pr_details.outputs.head_ref }}
          else
            echo "No changes to commit"
          fi

      - name: Post success comment
        if: success()
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }};
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: prNumber,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: `✅ **Progressive Rollout Version Bump Successful**
              
              Connector versions have been bumped with RC suffixes for progressive rollout.
              
              **Next Steps:**
              1. Verify the version changes in the PR diff.
              2. Ensure \`enableProgressiveRollout: true\` is set in \`metadata.yaml\` for affected connectors.
              3. Merge this PR to trigger the progressive rollout process.
              
              > Note: If you need to adjust the rollout configuration, please update the \`metadata.yaml\` files manually before merging.`
            })

      - name: Post failure comment
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const prNumber = ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }};
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: prNumber,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: `❌ **Progressive Rollout Version Bump Failed**
              
              The version bump process encountered an error. Please check the workflow logs for details.
              
              **Common Issues:**
              - Ensure the PR is based on a valid branch.
              - Check that \`airbyte-ci\` is properly installed and configured.
              - Verify that the connectors have valid version metadata.`
            })
```
